name: Baisangur Susurkaev
summary: An unbeaten Chechen middleweight from Kill Cliff FC (12-0, age 25), a Khamzat Chimaev teammate. 3-0 in the UFC since his Contender Series win: a R2 submission of Eric Nolan, a R3 TKO of Eric McConico and a R3 submission of Djorden Santos in May.

how_they_fight.Striking: Nine knockouts, seven of them in R1 (mostly regional).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Two submissions, both in the UFC (R2, R3).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: His UFC finishes all came in R2-R3: he wears opponents down.

patterns: Late finishes in the UFC (R2, R3, R3)
Early knockouts on the regional scene
concerns: Untested against a power puncher like Pinas
keys_to_beat: Hurt him early, before his pressure builds

news.text: Booked against Damian Pinas, who called him an 'easy' fight.
